_note: Template for a product. Copy to ./catalogs/<name>.json, edit every field, run `painpoint-radar keywords list --product <name>`. product = what to listen for; subreddits = where; presets = how wide. contact = the address the archives see in the User-Agent ($PAINPOINT_RADAR_CONTACT wins). comment_policy stays unknown until a human reads each sub's rules for THIS purpose.

product.name: Queuely
product.category: background job queues and task scheduling for web apps
product.relevance: the thread is about running background jobs, queues, workers, retries or scheduled tasks in a web application (Sidekiq, BullMQ, Celery, RabbitMQ, SQS, cron). Hiring posts, generic SaaS chatter and unrelated performance questions are NOT relevant.
